meta.one_liner: Intraday Donchian: buy a 15-minute close above the highest high of the past full session's worth of bars.
meta.explainer_md: The intraday cousin of the Donchian breakout, on 15-minute bars. It tracks the highest high of the last 26 bars — roughly one full trading session — and buys when a 15-minute close pushes above it, i.e. when price clears everything it traded at over the previous day of bars (extended hours included). The exit is symmetric and fast: a close back below the 20-bar average, a 1.5% stop, or a two-day time limit, whichever hits first. Note it is not a classic 'opening range' breakout — the range here is a rolling window of bars, not the first N minutes of each session — so that's not what we named it.

spec.name: 15-Minute Range Breakout
spec.description: 15m bars: close above the prior 26-bar high; exit under ema_20, 1.5% stop, 2-day limit.
